response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with strong fundamentals in software craftsmanship, this role requires highly specialized expertise largely absent from his background. He meets only 2 of 5 explicit required qualifications: he lacks native-level Japanese proficiency (critical for this likely Japanese-company role), has minimal C programming experience (only 6 months), shows no evidence of Linux kernel investigation capability, and has zero background in security technologies (encryption, authentication, threat detection). His career trajectory has been web-oriented; transitioning to embedded networking security firmware would require extensive domain-specific reskilling across multiple areas simultaneously.
strengths: Extensive 16+ year software development career demonstrating ability to rapidly learn diverse programming languages and adapt to new technical domains
Strong software engineering fundamentals including TDD, CI/CD pipelines, clean architecture, and infrastructure automation that could support embedded development practices
Some embedded systems exposure through robotic arms development at Altom and hardware-focused roles; demonstrates versatility beyond pure web development
concerns: Critical missing requirement: Zero native-level Japanese language proficiency (only English fluent, Romanian fluent, German basic); this is an explicit hard requirement typically non-negotiable

Insufficient C and embedded Linux foundation: Only 6 months of C/C++ experience; career predominantly in TypeScript, DLang, and web technologies; no evidence of kernel-level development or UNIX embedded work

No security domain specialization: Resume shows zero experience with cryptography, encryption protocols, authentication systems, threat detection, or security-focused development essential for this security-features role
